{{Top|leg}}
The '''Veejy fruit''' was a fruit from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]]. The fruit, which grew in large quantities all year long in the planet's rain forests, had an oblong shape with prickly skin. Its yellow flesh had a sweet taste, making it a particular delicacy to the native [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]], as well as a popular export. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] destroyed the planet's harvesting machines, but the veejy crops themselves were left untouched. As a result, veejy fruit export played a significant part in the planet's economic recovery after the war was over.
